name: SlotSetu
tagline: A state appointments portal where new slots open at 17:00 and vanish in minutes
summary: SlotSetu books appointments for passports, driving licences and certificates across a state: login with Aadhaar e-KYC, slot search, booking, document upload, fee payment and SMS confirmations. New slots for the next fortnight open at 17:00 every day, and agents' scripts compete with citizens for them. Slot pages that hang at 17:00, e-KYC failures and uploads that never finish keep coming back.

debts.title: Precompute availability per office and serve it cached
debts.desc: Compute each office's availability when it changes and serve the page from the cache.
debts.cause: Slot availability is computed on every request

debts.title: Rate limits, CAPTCHA and per-Aadhaar caps on booking
debts.desc: Show availability only after a CAPTCHA, rate-limit each device, allow two bookings per Aadhaar a month and release new appointments at random minutes after 17:00.
debts.cause: The portal has no CAPTCHA, per-Aadhaar limits or randomised slot release

debts.title: Fallback to mobile OTP login when e-KYC is down
debts.desc: Degrade gracefully: let citizens log in with a mobile OTP and complete Aadhaar e-KYC later when the gateway is down.
debts.cause: Login depends on live e-KYC with no fallback

debts.title: Resumable uploads with retry limits and backoff
debts.desc: Upload documents in chunks straight to object storage and retry only the failed chunk, with backoff and a retry limit, instead of starting again.
debts.cause: Uploads pass through the app server with no resumable upload

debts.title: Run MIS reports from a read replica
debts.desc: Move district MIS reports to a read replica and schedule them away from 17:00.
debts.cause: MIS reports run on the primary database

debts.title: Unique constraint and idempotent slot allocation
debts.desc: Add a unique constraint per slot and an idempotency key per booking request.
debts.cause: Slot allocation has no unique constraint or idempotent check

debts.title: Queue SMS confirmations with retries
debts.desc: Send confirmations from a queue at the provider's rate, with retries.
debts.cause: SMS is sent in bursts with no queue

debts.title: Run in both data-centre zones with automatic failover
debts.desc: Run every service in both zones behind one load balancer and fail over automatically, so losing a zone halves capacity instead of stopping the portal.
debts.cause: The portal is not deployed across both data-centre zones

debts.title: Reconcile pending payments with the treasury gateway
debts.desc: A reconciliation job checks pending payments every two minutes instead of waiting for the callback.
debts.cause: Payment status is only updated by the gateway's callback

debts.title: Separate connection pools for citizens and back-office jobs
debts.desc: Give citizen-facing services their own database pool.

debts.title: Load test the 17:00 release at 25x
debts.desc: Rehearse a slot release at 25 times normal traffic every month.

debts.title: Pre-render the portal's static pages and serve them cached from a CDN
debts.desc: Cache the portal's pages and scripts on a CDN.

debts.title: Use IST for every release time
debts.desc: Store and compare release times in IST (Asia/Kolkata).
